estonia.description: Americans commit to 'a strong NATO central to Euro-Atlantic collective defence'

estonia.title: INTERVIEW: Estonia rebuffs Berlin on EU budget cuts
estonia.description: Baltics provide more support to Kyiv than Germany relative to the size of their economies, Estonian finance minister tells Rapporteur

estonia.title: FIREPOWER: Nordic defence giants push joint initiatives
estonia.description: In today's edition: NATO, Finnish nuclear policy, Ukraine loan

estonia.title: Bencsik János szerint „kiragadott mondatok” miatt bélyegezték antiszemitának
estonia.description: Az egykori jobbikos politikus hosszú bejegyzésben adott számot a politika utáni pályájáról, és bocsánatot kért azoktól, akiket korábban megbántott.

estonia.title: „Átvertek minket” – Pillanatok alatt rémálommá vált Polyák Lilla és Gömöri András Máté költözése
Nové Maďarsko chce byť spoľahlivým partnerom EÚ a NATO. Prezident v Prahe vyzval aj na podporu Ukrajiny
estonia.description: Po rokoch napätých vzťahov s Bruselom avizuje Budapešť dôraz na spoluprácu a dialóg. Prezident Baka zároveň zdôraznil potrebu rešpektovať ukrajinskú suverenitu.

estonia.title: V Abú Dhabí jednali zástupci USA, Ukrajiny a Ruska, pokračovat budou ve středu
estonia.description: V Abú Dhabí skončily rozhovory Spojených států, Ukrajiny a Ruska o ukončení agrese Moskvy, pokračovat budou ve středu. Na místě jsou také zástupci evropských zemí, EU a NATO, kteří se však samotných třístranných rozhovorů přímo neúčastní. Tématem rozhovorů, která se ve třístranném formátu konají poprvé od letošního února, je nejen ukončení války, kterou Rusko rozpoutalo, ale také bezpečnostní záruky pro poválečnou Ukrajinu a budoucí systém evropské bezpečnosti. Konkrétní obsah jednání a jejich vývoj dosud účastníci nekomentovali. Analytici od jednání průlom nečekají.

estonia.title: Lecția lui Mansfield: trupele americane rămân acolo unde aliații le dau motive să rămână
estonia.description: Pe 19 mai 1971, Senatul Statelor Unite a respins, cu 61 de voturi la 36, amendamentul senatorului Mike Mansfield. Liderul majorității democrate cerea ca trupele americane din Europa să fie înjumătățite, la 150.000 de oameni, și avea în spate o țară obosită de Vietnam.

estonia.title: Un parlamentar ar vrea să îi propună lui Călin Georgescu să preia conducerea AUR. Peiu: Până în 2030, postul e ocupat de George Simion
estonia.description: Deputatul Mohammad Murad ar lua în calcul să îi propună lui Călin Georgescu să preia conducerea Alianței pentru Unirea Românilor (AUR), potrivit unor surse politice citate de Mediafax. Contactat de Digi24.ro, liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrișor Peiu, a exclus această posibilitate pentru perioada următoare, menționând că abia în anul 2030 partidul o să organizeze un nou Congres pentru alegerea conducerii.

estonia.title: Cum ar putea testa Rusia Articolul 5 al NATO. Scenariul îngrijorător pentru Europa, după înfrângerea lui Trump la alegerile din SUA
estonia.description: Înfrângerea republicanilor la alegerile de la jumătatea mandatului din Statele Unite ar putea avea consecințe importante asupra politicii externe a președintelui Donald Trump. Într-un scenariu extrem, Rusia ar putea încerca să testeze solidaritatea NATO, mizând pe faptul că Washingtonul nu va interveni în sprijinul aliaților europeni, avertizează experta în relații internaționale Liana Fix, într-o analiză publicată de revista germană FOCUS.

estonia.title: Nicoleta Pauliuc, către Ilie Bolojan: Riscaţi să duceţi PNL pe un drum în care dezbaterea e înlocuită cu ultimatumul. Nu mă intimidaţi
estonia.description: Senatorul PNL, Nicoleta Pauliuc, a transmis, luni seară, că nu se lasă intimidată de ultimatumul dat de liderul formaţiunii, Ilie Bolojan, pe care-l acuză că înlocuieşte libertatea de opinie cu obedienţa, iar dezbaterea cu ultimatumul.

estonia.title: Premieră medicală la Iași: cel mai mic pacient din România a primit un rinichi de la un bebeluș donator. „Am crezut că e un vis”
estonia.description: Șanse nesperate la o viață normală pentru doi copii, de doi, respectiv șase ani. A primit fiecare câte un rinichi nou, în urma unor intervenții contracronometru realizate de medicii de la Spitalul Parhon din Iași. În cazul copilului de doi ani, este o premieră: este cel mai tânăr pacient transplantat până acum în România. Salvarea a venit tot de la un copil, care s-a stins la nici un an și jumătate.

estonia.title: Un senator ex-SOS a trecut la grupul parlamentar PSD. Câți senatori din POT și SOS s-au afiliat până acum la social-democrați
estonia.description: Senatorul Ioan Rusu a anunţat, luni, în plen, afilierea la grupul parlamentar al Partidului Social Democrat (PSD).

estonia.title: Peiu: „AUR va încerca să depună moțiune de cenzură dacă Guvernul își angajează răspunderea pe reforma administrativ-teritorială”
estonia.description: AUR va încerca să depună o moțiune de cenzură dacă Guvernul își va angaja răspunderea pe reforma administrativ-teritorială, a anunțat luni liderul senatorilor formațiunii, Petrișor Peiu. Acesta susține că proiectul trebuie dezbătut în Parlament și negociat cu toate partidele, iar reorganizarea trebuie aplicată la nivel național, inclusiv în București.

estonia.title: Ilie Bolojan anunță că ușile PNL sunt deschise: pe cine așteaptă liderul liberal să se alăture partidului
estonia.description: Preşedintele PNL, senatorul Ilie Bolojan a făcut un apel, luni, către toţi oamenii care stăpânesc un domeniu, care au soluţii, să se alăture partidului, el arătând că cei care îşi vor vedea soluţiile preluate în politicile publice susţinute de PNL, uşile partidului sunt deschise.

estonia.title: PSD pregătește reforma administrativ-teritorială: șase criterii pentru reorganizarea localităților. Când va fi gata documentul
estonia.description: PSD propune șase criterii pentru stabilirea localităților sustenabile, în cadrul reformei administrativ-teritoriale, care ar urma să fie finalizată în luna martie. Printre cele luate în calcul se numără populația, sustenabilitatea economică, capacitatea administrativă, conectivitatea, accesul la servicii de bază și infrastructura publică. Europarlamentarul social-democrat Dragoș Benea, coordonatorul grupului de lucru pentru reformă, a precizat luni că primarii își vor duce actualele mandate până la capăt, în 2028, și că nu trebuie să existe temeri în această privință.

estonia.title: Reuniune la Paris pentru finanţarea reparării sarcofagului de la centrala nucleară Cernobîl, găurit de o dronă ruseasacă
estonia.description: Guvernul francez găzduieşte luni, la Paris, o „conferinţă a donatorilor” pentru a strânge fondurile rămase necesare pentru repararea structurii de protecţie de la centrala nucleară dezafectată de la Cernobîl, avariată în urma unui atac cu dronă rusesc la începutul anului 2025.

estonia.title: Cine este favoritul democraților pentru alegerile prezidențiale în SUA din 2028. Rezultatele unui sondaj intern
estonia.description: Recent realesul senator american Jon Ossoff, din statul Georgia, s-a impus în fruntea unui sondaj privind preferinţele pentru candidatura prezidenţială a Partidului Democrat pentru alegerile din 2028, sondaj realizat în cadrul convenţiei progresiste Crooked Con, care a avut loc în acest weekend la Washington, relatează EFE.

estonia.title: UE, Ucraina și SUA au discutat la Abu Dhabi despre garanțiile de securitate după încheierea războiului cu Rusia
estonia.description: Reprezentanți ai Uniunii Europene, Franței, Germaniei, Italiei, Regatului Unit, Ucrainei, Statelor Unite și NATO s-au reunit marți la Abu Dhabi, înaintea reluării negocierilor trilaterale cu Rusia, pentru a coordona eforturile de încheiere a războiului și pentru a discuta condițiile unei păci durabile, potrivit unui comunicat al Comisiei Europene. Discuțiile s-au concentrat în special pe garanțiile […] © G4Media.ro .

estonia.title: Opt ţări membre ale NATO îşi întăresc cooperarea în Marea Baltică printr-un exerciţiu comun cu submarine
estonia.description: Suedia găzduieşte de luni timp de cinci zile opt ţări membre ale NATO pentru un exerciţiu comun în Marea Baltică, un mediu maritim special, în scopul de a-şi dezvolta capacităţile comune de luptă antisubmarin, relatează agenția de știri AFP, citată de Agerpres. Numit Dynamic Merlin şi organizat în fiecare an, exerciţiul urmează să le permită […] © G4Media.ro .

estonia.title: Binturong breakout means Tallinn Zoo without a single Nicobar pigeon left alive
estonia.description: Tallinn Zoo has lost its entire collection of an exotic species of pigeon after being killed by two escaped binturongs, Eesti Ekspress reported.

estonia.title: Pensioners' party founder: Estonia must find more money, not take it away
estonia.description: The founder of a new political party representing older people in Estonia wants to give that demographic a voice, and to fund a rise in pensions by boosting the economy and industry.

estonia.title: Tallinn's 2027 budget prioritizes education and crisis preparedness
estonia.description: The Tallinn city government approved its draft 2027 budget on Tuesday. The budget totals €1.3 billion, including €168 million in investments.

estonia.title: Kaire Sepper: There are debts you can legally refuse to pay
estonia.description: Debts are meant to be repaid. At least in an ideal world. Yet there are debts that people can legally refuse to pay, but thousands still do so, writes Kaire Sepper.

estonia.title: Museum opens exhibition dedicated to Estonian children's favorite TV wolf
estonia.description: The Puppet Theater Museum will open "Hunt Kriimsilm on Air" on Friday, November 13, an exhibition dedicated to one of the most beloved characters in Estonian television history. The exhibition tells the story of the wolf's journey from the theater stage to television screens.

estonia.title: Estonia eyes former Tartu movie theater site for military academy expansion
estonia.description: A former movie theater in Central Tartu could make way for a new building as the state seeks more space for the Estonian Military Academy and Baltic Defense College.

estonia.title: Tallinn's Christmas tree to arrive in Old Town on Thursday
estonia.description: Tallinn's Christmas tree will be delivered to the Old Town on Thursday (November 12) and decorated over the weekend before the opening of the annual Christmas market at the end of November.

estonia.title: Estonians lose €21 million to scammers in nine months
estonia.description: April was the worst month for fraud in Estonia this year, with scammers stealing more than €4 million, including €1.7 million lost by a single company in an invoice fraud scheme known as business email compromise (BEC).

estonia.title: Niina Petrõkina: My rivals are now jumping 1,440 degrees, so I have to too
estonia.description: Estonian skater Niina Petrõkina says she will have to add a challenging quadruple jump to stay at the top, after setting personal bests in both programs and taking silver at the Grand Prix in Kelowna, British Columbia.

estonia.title: Health Insurance Fund suspends doctor's appointment reminder service after trial
estonia.description: The Estonian Health Insurance Fund has suspended its new appointment reminder service after testing revealed inaccurate patient information and duplicate notifications.

estonia.title: Presidential security adviser: Abu Dhabi talks unlikely to stop the war
estonia.description: Ukraine, Russia and the U.S. begin talks in Abu Dhabi on Tuesday, but Rainer Saks, security adviser to the President, says a ceasefire is unlikely at this stage.

estonia.title: Economy minister refuses to approve Estonia's Nutri-Score law
estonia.description: Minister of Economy and Industry Liina Vahtras (Reform) declined to approve a draft regulation introducing Nutri-Score food labeling, citing the need to examine alternatives and address concerns raised by food producers.

estonia.title: Narva high schoolers paired with Estonian language buddies in Järva County
estonia.description: A new high school elective launched this week pairs Estonian-speaking teens in Järva County with Narva peers learning Estonian as a second language.

estonia.title: Tõnu Väät: 9 out of 10 packages from Asia clear customs outside Estonia
estonia.description: If we want the next logistics hub to be built in Estonia, we must adopt European regulations without adding our own extra requirements, writes Tõnu Väät.

estonia.title: International film congress in Tallinn focuses on funding and artificial intelligence
estonia.description: The World Congress of Science and Factual Producers is taking place at Kultuurikatel through Thursday. Held in Tallinn to mark the 30th anniversary of the Black Nights Film Festival (PÖFF), the event has attracted nearly 600 participants from more than 30 countries.

estonia.title: Pharmacists warn vending machines could spell the end of rural drugstores
estonia.description: Estonia is considering allowing pharmacy vending machines to provide round-the-clock access to prescription and over-the-counter medications, but pharmacists warn the move could threaten the survival of small rural pharmacies.

estonia.title: Imre Kaas: When the government charges you for being stupid
estonia.description: Although citizens and the state are part of the same whole, many people are left with a bitter taste in their mouths after their everyday dealings with government, Imre Kaas argues in his daily commentary on Vikerraadio.

estonia.title: Accountants go on strike over new labor taxes declaration system
estonia.description: A warning strike by Estonian accountants on November 10–11 aims to draw public attention to the failure of the new system for submitting employment tax declarations.

estonia.title: Estonia plans care coordinators to stop patients returning to hospital
estonia.description: Estonia will introduce care coordinators from May 2028 to help people with extensive care needs manage at home, after the Riigikogu social affairs committee discussed the reform.

estonia.title: Estonian Rubik's Cube champ: Anyone can learn to solve it blindfolded
estonia.description: Seven-time Estonian cubing champion Kaur Tuule says with enough practice and a good grasp of the algorithms, anyone can learn to solve a cube with their eyes closed.

estonia.title: Estonia's export boost driven by economic growth in Finland and Sweden
estonia.description: Economic growth in neighboring Finland and Sweden has boosted Estonia's exports in recent months, LHV macroeconomic analyst Triinu Tapver has said.

estonia.title: Foreign minister announces new ministry secretary general
estonia.description: Minister of Foreign Affairs Margus Tsahkna (Eesti 200) said on Monday that former state secretary Taimar Peterkop will become the ministry's new secretary general.

estonia.title: Estonia celebrates mardipäev or St. Martin's Day
estonia.description: Mardipäev, Martinmas or St. Martin's Day is an Estonian folk calendar holiday held on November 10. The most common tradition includes dressing up as often scary or slightly monstrous beggars and showing up on people's doorsteps singing, dancing, and often playfully flogging the host.

estonia.title: Design historian: Japanese design is part of our lives
estonia.description: The exhibition "Japanese Design Today" at the Estonian Museum of Applied Art and Design offers visitors an opportunity to explore changes in Japanese society, culture and daily life through design. Many aspects of our own lives in the Western cultural sphere have roots that stretch back to Japan, says museum director and design historian Kai Lobjakas.

estonia.title: New Estonian party Generations hopes to represent elderly voters at 2027 elections
estonia.description: A new political party called Generations, focused on representing older people's interests, hopes to recruit enough members needed for registration and run in the upcoming Riigikogu elections.

estonia.title: Hotell Fonnental in Tallinn's Kadriorg put up for sale
estonia.description: The property housing the Hotell Fonnental and the Gourmet Coffee cafe in Tallinn's Kadriorg has been put up for sale by owners, Baltinn OÜ. The company is asking €4,836,000 for the property.

estonia.title: Lajal reclaims top Estonian spot in latest tennis rankings
estonia.description: Mark Lajal has reclaimed his position as Estonia's top-ranked active tennis player, moving back ahead of Daniil Glinka with a six-place jump in the latest ATP rankings.

estonia.title: Finance committee reviews half of proposed state budget amendments
estonia.description: Members of the Riigikogu Finance Committee reviewed roughly half of the amendments submitted to the 2027 state budget bill during a meeting on Monday.

estonia.title: Single dad teaching Ukrainian kids: Father's Day is a tough subject
estonia.description: An Estonian teacher in Pärnu says his experience as a single father helps him better understand Ukrainian students separated from their fathers by the war.

estonia.title: New report reveals shortcomings in Estonian MoD's handling of Datasel transactions
estonia.description: A Ministry of Defense review of contracts with ammunition supplier Datasel found shortcomings in background checks, risk assessments and documentation, but no evidence of deliberate concealment or deletion of records.

estonia.title: Finance minister explains why government rejected fuel excise tax cuts
estonia.description: The Estonian government opposes three opposition-backed bills that would reduce fuel excise taxes. The Ministry of Finance argues the measures would significantly reduce state revenue while having only a limited effect on prices at the pump.

estonia.title: Tartu joins Ukrainian city-led Unbroken Cities crisis preparedness network
estonia.description: Tartu has joined an international network launched by Lviv to help European cities learn from Ukraine's wartime lessons in crisis preparedness and urban resilience.

estonia.title: Tallinn postpones phone-tap public transport fare validation
estonia.description: While Tartu already offers phone-based fare validation on public transport, Tallinn is pushing back the launch of its own tap-to-validate system until next spring.

estonia.title: Gallery: Pärnu show traces fate of Finnish islands ceded to Soviet rule
estonia.description: A new exhibition at the Pärnu Museum of New Art (MONA) explores Suursaari and other Finnish islands ceded to the Soviet Union after the Winter War through photos and memories.

estonia.title: Natalie Mets: The economy also depends on young people getting into the workforce
estonia.description: Technological development is increasingly changing how companies operate and the number of workers they need. Young people face the greatest risk from these changes, writes Natalie Mets.

estonia.title: How is Estonia protecting itself against intensifying cyberthreats?
estonia.description: A cyberattack this week caused refrigerators at a Selver supermarket to heat up to 50 degrees Celsius. Similar incidents were reported in 11 European countries, raising concerns about the vulnerability of essential everyday systems.

estonia.title: Estonian scientists create new comprehensive model for measuring child welfare
estonia.description: A new Estonian child well-being model aims to provide a more comprehensive picture of how children are doing, helping policymakers identify inequalities and direct support where it is needed most.

estonia.title: Estonian foreign minister on Abu Dhabi talks: Best possible outcome would be a ceasefire
estonia.description: Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna said there is no reason to fear that this week's U.S.-mediated talks on the Russia-Ukraine war in Abu Dhabi will result in some broader European peace settlement. The best possible outcome would be a ceasefire, although Tsahkna personally does not believe one will be achieved.

estonia.title: Kaarel Vanamölder and Madli Vanamölder: Praise tools!
estonia.description: Artificial intelligence is just another tool, much like the power tools that transformed construction or word processors that revolutionized writing. Rather than demonizing AI, we should learn to use it skillfully and take responsibility for the results, write Kaarel Vanamölder and Madli Vanamölder.

estonia.title: Mart Võsu: State should not treat entrepreneurs as if they don't know how to count money
estonia.description: The Ministry of Climate appears to believe Estonian entrepreneurs do not know how to count money. How else can one explain a draft proposal that would require businesses to renovate old commercial and industrial buildings, asks Mart Võsu.

estonia.title: Estonia's exports grew by 6% in third quarter
estonia.description: In the third quarter, exports of goods grew by 6 percent and imports by 7 percent, data from Statistics Estonia shows.

estonia.title: Parties differ on how to secure more money for health care
estonia.description: A recent audit by the National Audit Office found Estonia's health care funding model is unsustainable, prompting broad agreement among politicians that resources must be used more effectively, even as they disagree on whether additional funding is needed and how to secure it.

estonia.title: Estonia's domestic pig numbers still below pre-African swine fever levels
estonia.description: Eight of 11 pig farms hit by African swine fever (ASF) last summer have restocked, but despite no new outbreaks this year, Estonia's domestic pig numbers have yet to recover.

estonia.title: Expert: Ukrainian security and Russia's ambitions rule out U.S. deal
estonia.description: President Donald Trump's push for a sweeping security agreement with Russia covering Ukraine and Europe is unlikely to make peace negotiations easier or faster, ICDS Senior Research Fellow Liis Mure tells ERR.

estonia.title: Estonian real estate developer to build new city district in Latvia's Riga
estonia.description: Estonian real estate developer Invego plans to demolish Riga's Skonto, the home stadium of the Latvian national football team, and will build a new, modern urban district in its place.

estonia.title: New packaging law draws both praise and criticism from manufacturers
estonia.description: The Estonian Chamber of Agriculture and Commerce has said it supports the government's plan to abolish the excise duty on packaging but has criticized additional reporting rules.

estonia.title: Cheap energy and lower food prices: EKRE announces 2027 election platform
estonia.description: The Conservative People's Party of Estonia (EKRE) presented and adopted its election platform in Tartu on Sunday in advance of the March 2027 election.

estonia.title: New Estonian dialect lesson rules raise questions among teachers, students
estonia.description: Students and school leaders have concerns over the Ministry of Education's new draft legislation aimed at expanding the teaching of Estonia's regional dialects.

estonia.title: Tartu Peace Treaty talks table on display at Ministry of Foreign Affairs
estonia.description: The historic negotiating table used during the Tartu Peace Treaty talks between Estonia and the Soviet Union (1919-1920) is now temporarily on display at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

estonia.title: Demand for raw milk leading to supermarket shortages, farmers say
estonia.description: Farmers have said there are no milk shortages in Estonia – despite gaps on supermarket shelves – but competition for raw milk has intensified as companies look for ways to make higher-value items, such as protein-rich products.

estonia.title: Soome spordijurist: jäähoki võib halvemal juhul olümpiakavast välja lennata!
estonia.description: Rahvusvahelise Spordiarbitraaži (CAS) oktoobri lõpus tehtud otsus lubada Venemaa hokikoondised MMidele tagasi kütab kirgi juba teist nädalat. Ning lõppu niipea ei paista. Oma sõna ütlevad sekka juristid, kes hoiatavad kiirustatud sammude astumise eest.

estonia.title: Dresdenis uuritakse, kuidas tuumajäätmeid kütusena kasutada
estonia.description: Saksamaa teadlased on uurinud uudset meetodit, et muuta kasutatud tuumakütus vähese süsinikuheitega energiaks. Dresdeni Tehnikaülikooli teostatavusuuring visandab plaanid teedrajava ringlussevõtureaktori DEMO rajamiseks.

estonia.title: AINULAADNE KONTSERT PÄRNUS ⟩ Andres Kaljuste: Elleril on palju head muusikat, aga enamasti ei teata peale «Kodumaise viisi» midagi
estonia.description: Dirigent ja viiuldaja Andres Kaljuste toob Pärnus esimest korda publiku ette oma orkestriseaded Heino Elleri viiulipaladest. Üks neist on esitamist oodanud koroonaajast saadik.

estonia.title: Ura jõgi vabanes ajahamba puretud paisust
estonia.description: Ura jõel lõppenud looduskaitsetööde käigus lammutati amortiseerunud paisuregulaator ja rajati selle asemele kaladele paremini läbitav kärestik. Eesmärk oli taastada jõe loomulik toimimine ja parandada vee-elanike liikumisvõimalusi.

estonia.title: PÖFF-I NOPPEID ⟩ Inimeseks olemise võimalikkusest tsirkusefriigina
estonia.description: Võtta fookusesse ja tuua esile inimese tundemaailm, kelle juures kõik ülejäänud näevad vaid tema iseäralikku välimust, on keeruline ülesanne, millega läti režissöör Viesturs Kairišs on meisterlikult hakkama saanud. Portree maailma üheks edukamaks naiskorvpalluriks tõusnud Uljana Semjonovast on tehtud äärmise pieteeditunde ja südamlikkusega, näidates üles lugupidamist, mis naisele iseäranis tema keerulistel kujunemisaastatel kahjuks eriti osaks ei saanud.

estonia.title: Miks koer kallutab pead, kui sa temaga räägid? Eksperdid annavad vastuse
estonia.description: Paljud koeraomanikud on märganud, kuidas nende lemmik kallutab pead ühele küljele, kui temaga rääkida, mõnda küsimust esitada või tavapärasest erinevat häält teha. See armas žest tekitab sageli tunde, nagu püüaks koer inimese sõnadest aru saada. Aga miks ta tegelikult nii teeb?

estonia.title: VIDEO ⟩ Isamaa valimisnimekirjaga liitunud Jüri Luik: peame valmis olema igaks stsenaariumiks
estonia.description: Endine kaitseminister ja Eesti endine alaline esindaja NATO juures Jüri Luik ütles, et Isamaaga suurde poliitikasse naasmise otsus ei sündinud kiiresti. Tema sõnul vajab Eesti praeguses julgeolekuolukorras välis- ja kaitsepoliitika asjatundjaid nii riigiametisse kui ka poliitikasse.

estonia.title: Krõbedad kartulipesad peekoni, juustu ja sibulaga
estonia.description: Need väikesed kuldsed kartulipesad on tõeline maiuspala kõigile kartuli- ja juustusõpradele! Kreemine kartulipuder, krõbe suitsupeekon, praetud sibul ja sulanud juust moodustavad koosluse, millele on raske vastu panna

estonia.title: Poola justiitsminister: Krakowi tulistaja oli vaimustuses Norra neonatsist massimõrvarist
estonia.description: Krakowi kesklinnas kuus inimest tapmises kahtlustatav relvastatud mees tundis suurt huvi Norra kurikuulsa massimõrvari vastu, ütles Poola justiitsminister teisipäeval.

estonia.title: Maksmata elektriarved läksid tarbijale kalliks maksma
estonia.description: Kui mitu kuud elektriarveid maksmata jätta, võib hiljem saabuda ebameeldiv üllatus. Üks tarbija avastas, et lisaks tasumata elektri eest tekkinud võlale tuleb tal maksta ka üle 200 euro sissenõudmiskulusid. Tarbija arvates küsis elektrimüüja neid põhjendamatult palju, sest arvestas tasu iga kuu võlgnevuse eest eraldi. Tarbijavaidluste komisjon leidis aga, et kauplejal oli selleks õigus.

estonia.title: Tallinnas on koolikohata noorte arv poole võrra vähenenud
estonia.description: Tallinnas on koolikohata noorte arv pooleteise kuuga vähenenud 158-lt 78-le, kuid linnal pole endiselt õnnestunud kõigi peredega ühendust saada, sest mõned lapsed võivad viibida välismaal.

estonia.title: Eaka naise alla ajanud ukrainlane läheb aastateks vangi, sest ei täitnud tingimisi karistuse nõudeid
estonia.description: 2023. aasta kevadel eakale naisele otsa tagurdanud ja tema surma põhjustanud ukrainlane ei suutnud talle määratud kriminaalhooldusnõudeid täita ning seega muutub talle algselt tingimisi määratud karistus reaalseks vangistuseks.

estonia.title: Enam kui 30 aastat tegutsenud Eesti transpordifirma esitas pankrotiavalduse
estonia.description: Eesti-sisese kaubaveoga enam kui kolm aastakümmet tegelenud Rain Transport AS esitas tänavu kevadel Tartu maakohtule saneerimisavalduse, kuna kütuse ja tööjõu kallinemine oli tekitanud ettevõttele likviidsusprobleemi. Kuigi kohus kinnitas saneerimiskava, esitas ettevõte lõpuks ise pankrotiavalduse.

estonia.title: Rahanduskomisjon saatis tuleva aasta riigieelarve eelnõu teisele lugemisele
estonia.description: Riigikogu rahanduskomisjon vaatas läbi tuleva aasta riigieelarve eelnõule fraktsioonidelt ja riigikogu liikmetelt ning rahanduskomisjonilt endalt laekunud muudatusettepanekud. Valitsuse algatatud 2027. aasta riigieelarve seaduse eelnõu teine lugemine toimub kolmapäeval.

estonia.title: SAAME TUTTAVAKS ⟩ 18-aastane eestlanna lõi Euroopa edukaimas korvpalliklubis ukse jalaga lahti
estonia.description: Kui Eesti meeste seas leidub Vana Maailma klubikorvpalli tugeval tasemel rohkelt tegijaid, pole seis naiste seas kaugeltki nõnda hea. Seda enam tasub tunnustada Laura Liisa Grünmanni, kes on alustanud hooaega kuulsas Riia TTT-s säravalt.

estonia.title: INTERVJUU ⟩ Reformierakonna kunagine kauaaegne kampaaniameister osaleb seekord ka ise riigikogu valimistel
estonia.description: Andrus Ansipi ajal Reformierakonna kampaaniameister olnud kommunikatsiooniekspert Annika Arras kandideerib kevadistel riigikogu valimistel.

estonia.title: Lemmiktoit ei maitse enam nii nagu varem? Selle taga võib olla üllatav põhjus
estonia.description: Aastatega võib juhtuda, et toit ei paku enam päris samasugust elamust. See ei tähenda tingimata, et retsept oleks muutunud või kokk oma oskused kaotanud. Põhjus võib peituda hoopis meie meeltes.

estonia.title: MATTIAS JÕESAAR ⟩ Ma ei mõista vene keele (taas)kasutust ukrainlaste seas. Vallutussõda on venestamise tagajärg
estonia.description: Ma ei mõista ukrainlasi, kes omavahel (taas) vene keeles räägivad. Eriti vähe mõistan läände põgenenud ukrainlaste klammerdumist vene keele külge, kirjutab arvamustoimetaja Mattias Jõesaar.

estonia.title: ÜHEKS ÕHTUKS ⟩ Rühmitus Õigem Valem toob kokku Eesti nullindate luuleilma
estonia.description: Üheksakümnendate lõpuaastail tegutsenud luulerühmitus Õigem Valem tuleb veel kord kokku, et oma tekste esitades austada ja meenutada varalahkunud rühmituseliiget Kalju Kruusat.

estonia.title: VIDEOLUGU ⟩ «Ta natukene pirtsutab veel!» Hiinast tellitud 20 000-eurone imemasin valmistab Harjumaal ilma kokata sooja toitu
estonia.description: Harjumaal Habaja viinavabriku juures seisab juba paar kuud omapärane masin, mis võiks tulevikus muuta seda, kuidas eestlased kiiresti sooja kõhutäie saavad. Viinavabriku omanik ja endine ajakirjanik Villy Paimets tõi Hiinast Eestisse pea 20 000 eurot maksva toiduautomaadi, mis valmistab ilma ühegi koka abita värskeid friikartuleid ja muid suupisteid. «See on tulevik ju!» usub Paimets, kuigi uudse masina tööle saamine on nõudnud omajagu närve ja kannatust.

latvia.title: Europe and US unite behind NATO ahead of Russia talks
latvia.description: Americans commit to 'a strong NATO central to Euro-Atlantic collective defence'

latvia.title: FIREPOWER: Nordic defence giants push joint initiatives
latvia.description: In today's edition: NATO, Finnish nuclear policy, Ukraine loan

latvia.title: Bencsik János szerint „kiragadott mondatok” miatt bélyegezték antiszemitának
latvia.description: Az egykori jobbikos politikus hosszú bejegyzésben adott számot a politika utáni pályájáról, és bocsánatot kért azoktól, akiket korábban megbántott.

Donald Trump bejelentette, az FBI is nyomoz az Nvidia vezére körüli kínai kémügyben

latvia.description: Független vizsgálatot indított vasárnap az Nvidia igazgatósága, miután kiderült, hogy Jensen Huang vezérigazgató szoros kapcsolatot ápolt egy kínai üzletasszonnyal, akit az amerikai hatóságok a kínai titkosszolgálatokhoz kötnek. Huang a cég alkalmazottainak írt levelében elismerte, hogy hűtlen volt a feleségéhez, és teljes felelősséget vállalt az ügyért. Az érintett Alice Huang a szingapúri Megaspeed egyik vezetője, a céget pedig korábban azzal is gyanúsították az amerikai hatóságok, hogy segíthet kijátszani az amerikai chipexport korlátozásait. A botrány az Nvidia árfolyamán is meglátszott, és a Google-keresések alapján pedig Magyarországon és világszerte is az internet egyik legfelkapottabb témája lett.

latvia.title: Asztalra csapott a MÁV vezére: kiraboltak két vasúti kocsit az éjjel, ezért borult a menetrend
latvia.description: Kirabolták két Railjet vasúti szerelvény étkezőkocsiját keddre virradó éjszaka a budapesti Keleti pályaudvaron, amelyek emiatt nem tudtak elindulni - közölte Hegyi Zsolt, a MÁV-csoport vezérigazgatója kedden a Facebookon .

latvia.description: A mesterséges intelligencia két év alatt megduplázta stratégiai súlyát a HR-esek körében, miközben a vezetőfejlesztés továbbra is a legfőbb üzleti prioritás marad – derül ki a DEVELOR több mint 1300 nemzetközi HR- és L&D-vezető megkérdezésével készült L&D Kaleidoscope kutatásából. latvia.title: Nové Maďarsko chce byť spoľahlivým partnerom EÚ a NATO. Prezident v Prahe vyzval aj na podporu Ukrajiny
latvia.description: Po rokoch napätých vzťahov s Bruselom avizuje Budapešť dôraz na spoluprácu a dialóg. Prezident Baka zároveň zdôraznil potrebu rešpektovať ukrajinskú suverenitu.

latvia.title: V Abú Dhabí jednali zástupci USA, Ukrajiny a Ruska, pokračovat budou ve středu
latvia.description: V Abú Dhabí skončily rozhovory Spojených států, Ukrajiny a Ruska o ukončení agrese Moskvy, pokračovat budou ve středu. Na místě jsou také zástupci evropských zemí, EU a NATO, kteří se však samotných třístranných rozhovorů přímo neúčastní. Tématem rozhovorů, která se ve třístranném formátu konají poprvé od letošního února, je nejen ukončení války, kterou Rusko rozpoutalo, ale také bezpečnostní záruky pro poválečnou Ukrajinu a budoucí systém evropské bezpečnosti. Konkrétní obsah jednání a jejich vývoj dosud účastníci nekomentovali. Analytici od jednání průlom nečekají.

latvia.title: Lecția lui Mansfield: trupele americane rămân acolo unde aliații le dau motive să rămână
latvia.description: Pe 19 mai 1971, Senatul Statelor Unite a respins, cu 61 de voturi la 36, amendamentul senatorului Mike Mansfield. Liderul majorității democrate cerea ca trupele americane din Europa să fie înjumătățite, la 150.000 de oameni, și avea în spate o țară obosită de Vietnam.

latvia.title: Un parlamentar ar vrea să îi propună lui Călin Georgescu să preia conducerea AUR. Peiu: Până în 2030, postul e ocupat de George Simion
latvia.description: Deputatul Mohammad Murad ar lua în calcul să îi propună lui Călin Georgescu să preia conducerea Alianței pentru Unirea Românilor (AUR), potrivit unor surse politice citate de Mediafax. Contactat de Digi24.ro, liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrișor Peiu, a exclus această posibilitate pentru perioada următoare, menționând că abia în anul 2030 partidul o să organizeze un nou Congres pentru alegerea conducerii.

latvia.title: Cum ar putea testa Rusia Articolul 5 al NATO. Scenariul îngrijorător pentru Europa, după înfrângerea lui Trump la alegerile din SUA
latvia.description: Înfrângerea republicanilor la alegerile de la jumătatea mandatului din Statele Unite ar putea avea consecințe importante asupra politicii externe a președintelui Donald Trump. Într-un scenariu extrem, Rusia ar putea încerca să testeze solidaritatea NATO, mizând pe faptul că Washingtonul nu va interveni în sprijinul aliaților europeni, avertizează experta în relații internaționale Liana Fix, într-o analiză publicată de revista germană FOCUS.

latvia.title: Nicoleta Pauliuc, către Ilie Bolojan: Riscaţi să duceţi PNL pe un drum în care dezbaterea e înlocuită cu ultimatumul. Nu mă intimidaţi
latvia.description: Senatorul PNL, Nicoleta Pauliuc, a transmis, luni seară, că nu se lasă intimidată de ultimatumul dat de liderul formaţiunii, Ilie Bolojan, pe care-l acuză că înlocuieşte libertatea de opinie cu obedienţa, iar dezbaterea cu ultimatumul.

latvia.title: Premieră medicală la Iași: cel mai mic pacient din România a primit un rinichi de la un bebeluș donator. „Am crezut că e un vis”
latvia.description: Șanse nesperate la o viață normală pentru doi copii, de doi, respectiv șase ani. A primit fiecare câte un rinichi nou, în urma unor intervenții contracronometru realizate de medicii de la Spitalul Parhon din Iași. În cazul copilului de doi ani, este o premieră: este cel mai tânăr pacient transplantat până acum în România. Salvarea a venit tot de la un copil, care s-a stins la nici un an și jumătate.

latvia.title: Un senator ex-SOS a trecut la grupul parlamentar PSD. Câți senatori din POT și SOS s-au afiliat până acum la social-democrați
latvia.description: Senatorul Ioan Rusu a anunţat, luni, în plen, afilierea la grupul parlamentar al Partidului Social Democrat (PSD).

latvia.title: Peiu: „AUR va încerca să depună moțiune de cenzură dacă Guvernul își angajează răspunderea pe reforma administrativ-teritorială”
latvia.description: AUR va încerca să depună o moțiune de cenzură dacă Guvernul își va angaja răspunderea pe reforma administrativ-teritorială, a anunțat luni liderul senatorilor formațiunii, Petrișor Peiu. Acesta susține că proiectul trebuie dezbătut în Parlament și negociat cu toate partidele, iar reorganizarea trebuie aplicată la nivel național, inclusiv în București.

latvia.title: Ilie Bolojan anunță că ușile PNL sunt deschise: pe cine așteaptă liderul liberal să se alăture partidului
latvia.description: Preşedintele PNL, senatorul Ilie Bolojan a făcut un apel, luni, către toţi oamenii care stăpânesc un domeniu, care au soluţii, să se alăture partidului, el arătând că cei care îşi vor vedea soluţiile preluate în politicile publice susţinute de PNL, uşile partidului sunt deschise.

latvia.title: PSD pregătește reforma administrativ-teritorială: șase criterii pentru reorganizarea localităților. Când va fi gata documentul
latvia.description: PSD propune șase criterii pentru stabilirea localităților sustenabile, în cadrul reformei administrativ-teritoriale, care ar urma să fie finalizată în luna martie. Printre cele luate în calcul se numără populația, sustenabilitatea economică, capacitatea administrativă, conectivitatea, accesul la servicii de bază și infrastructura publică. Europarlamentarul social-democrat Dragoș Benea, coordonatorul grupului de lucru pentru reformă, a precizat luni că primarii își vor duce actualele mandate până la capăt, în 2028, și că nu trebuie să existe temeri în această privință.

latvia.title: Reuniune la Paris pentru finanţarea reparării sarcofagului de la centrala nucleară Cernobîl, găurit de o dronă ruseasacă
latvia.description: Guvernul francez găzduieşte luni, la Paris, o „conferinţă a donatorilor” pentru a strânge fondurile rămase necesare pentru repararea structurii de protecţie de la centrala nucleară dezafectată de la Cernobîl, avariată în urma unui atac cu dronă rusesc la începutul anului 2025.

latvia.title: Cine este favoritul democraților pentru alegerile prezidențiale în SUA din 2028. Rezultatele unui sondaj intern
latvia.description: Recent realesul senator american Jon Ossoff, din statul Georgia, s-a impus în fruntea unui sondaj privind preferinţele pentru candidatura prezidenţială a Partidului Democrat pentru alegerile din 2028, sondaj realizat în cadrul convenţiei progresiste Crooked Con, care a avut loc în acest weekend la Washington, relatează EFE.

latvia.title: UE, Ucraina și SUA au discutat la Abu Dhabi despre garanțiile de securitate după încheierea războiului cu Rusia
latvia.description: Reprezentanți ai Uniunii Europene, Franței, Germaniei, Italiei, Regatului Unit, Ucrainei, Statelor Unite și NATO s-au reunit marți la Abu Dhabi, înaintea reluării negocierilor trilaterale cu Rusia, pentru a coordona eforturile de încheiere a războiului și pentru a discuta condițiile unei păci durabile, potrivit unui comunicat al Comisiei Europene. Discuțiile s-au concentrat în special pe garanțiile […] © G4Media.ro .

latvia.title: Opt ţări membre ale NATO îşi întăresc cooperarea în Marea Baltică printr-un exerciţiu comun cu submarine
latvia.description: Suedia găzduieşte de luni timp de cinci zile opt ţări membre ale NATO pentru un exerciţiu comun în Marea Baltică, un mediu maritim special, în scopul de a-şi dezvolta capacităţile comune de luptă antisubmarin, relatează agenția de știri AFP, citată de Agerpres. Numit Dynamic Merlin şi organizat în fiecare an, exerciţiul urmează să le permită […] © G4Media.ro .

latvia.title: Estonia plans care coordinators to stop patients returning to hospital
latvia.description: Estonia will introduce care coordinators from May 2028 to help people with extensive care needs manage at home, after the Riigikogu social affairs committee discussed the reform.

latvia.title: Estonian real estate developer to build new city district in Latvia's Riga
latvia.description: Estonian real estate developer Invego plans to demolish Riga's Skonto, the home stadium of the Latvian national football team, and will build a new, modern urban district in its place.

latvia.title: VIDEO ⟩ Isamaa valimisnimekirjaga liitunud Jüri Luik: peame valmis olema igaks stsenaariumiks
latvia.description: Endine kaitseminister ja Eesti endine alaline esindaja NATO juures Jüri Luik ütles, et Isamaaga suurde poliitikasse naasmise otsus ei sündinud kiiresti. Tema sõnul vajab Eesti praeguses julgeolekuolukorras välis- ja kaitsepoliitika asjatundjaid nii riigiametisse kui ka poliitikasse.

latvia.title: Kulbergs signals austerity intentions with lengthy presentation
latvia.description: Latvian Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (United List) called a special press conference on Tuesday, November 11th to explain the state of the country's economy to the public and signal his future intentions.

latvia.title: Nearly half of Latvia's scientists and engineers are women
latvia.description: In 2025, there were 20.2 million scientists and engineers in the EU, of whom 8.2 million, or 41%, were women, according to Eurostat data published on November 10th.

latvia.title: Special 'Patriot Week' Latvian film selection to be available online
latvia.description: From Lāčplēsis Day, November 11th, the National Film Centre's website filmas.lv will launch its Patriot Week Online Festival – a selection of Latvian films, which will be available for free to watch anytime and anywhere in the world where you have an internet connection.

latvia.title: Latvian foreign trade was strongly on the rise in September
latvia.description: Trade stats published by the Central Statistical Bureau (CSB) on November 10th provide some encouraging news on the direction of Latvia's foreign trade.

latvia.title: Latvia's annual inflation rate at 3.1% in October
latvia.description: Compared with October 2025, the average level of consumer prices in Latvia rose by 3.1 % in October 2026, according to data published by the Central Statistics Bureau (CSB) on November 10th.

latvia.title: No holiday/workday switching for Latvia in 2027
latvia.description: No working days will be 'moved' next year because the government did not make a decision on this by the time the necessary deadline passed.

latvia.title: Staro Rīga light festival to be more disability-friendly this year
latvia.description: From 15 to 18 November, Riga will host the annual ‘Staro Rīga’ light festival, which this year, for the first time, will be made more accessible to blind and visually impaired people, the organisers announced.

latvia.title: Group of skinheads detained in Rīga, Latvia
latvia.description: On 29 October, the State Police (VP), in cooperation with the State Security Service (VDD), arrested four skinheads, including minors. The criminal investigation is ongoing.

latvia.title: Police keep watchful eye on forest quad bikers
latvia.description: At the end of October, the Ropaži Municipal Police initiated seven cases for offences relating to riding motorbikes and quad bikes in forests and nature reserves where this is not permitted, whilst video cameras and drones are increasingly being used to detect offenders, Latvian Television reports on November 10.

latvia.title: Check the weather! Latvian beliefs on Mārtiņdiena
latvia.description: On November 10, Latvia traditionally marks Mārtiņdiena – the middle point between the autumn and winter solstice, when the harvest has been collected and the long winter is ahead.

latvia.title: Latvia's culture sector to protest Tuesday
latvia.description: A protest by the cultural sector is due to take place on Tuesday, calling for a change in the state’s attitude. ‘We also want to promote the understanding that culture is something to which every citizen is entitled,’ said Indra Lūkina, director of the Latvian National Symphony Orchestra and a board member of the Association of Professional Music Ensembles of Latvia, on the Latvian Radio programme ‘Labrīt’.

latvia.title: Extremely high electricity exchange prices Monday in Latvia
latvia.description: Electricity prices in Latvia reached an unusually high level for this time of year on Monday, 9 November. On the power exchange, electricity costs almost four times as much as the October average; moreover, it is half the price in Estonia, Latvian Television reported.

latvia.description: On 9th November 2026, an emergency meeting of the UN Security Council (UNSC) on the subject of Ukraine has been called by Latvia.

latvia.title: ERR: Estonian company to replace Skonto stadium with new urban quarter
latvia.description: Estonian real estate developer Invego plans to demolish Riga's Skonto stadium, the home of the Latvian national football team, as part of a new urban construction project, reports Estonian public media ERR.

latvia.title: Sex criminal handed lengthy sentence after years of abuse
latvia.description: The man admitted his guilt and entered into a plea agreement with the prosecutor.

latvia.title: Latvian house prices remain relatively affordable
latvia.description: New Eurostat data published on November 9th shows that while Latvia's house prices continue to rise fairly quickly, real estate remains fairly affordable for locals when compared with some other parts of Europe.

latvia.title: Slower driving on Dienvidu Bridge in Rīga as of Friday
latvia.description: Starting 13 November, on the Dienvidu Bridge flyovers in Riga, the speed limit will be reduced from 70 km/h to 50 km/h during the winter season.

latvia.title: Who let the dogs out? Call for clarity over canine leash laws
latvia.description: Seven animal protection associations have appealed to the Latvian Union of Local Governments, calling on them to ensure that pet owners have clarity about when and where they can let their dogs off the leash.

latvia.title: Mini-series dramatises Latvia's national alert info
latvia.description: Latvia's State Fire and Rescue Service (VUGD) has published a series of short videos on the subject of emergency preparedness.

latvia.title: Lielīvande manor complex looking for new hands
latvia.description: Kuldīga Municipal Council is determined to find a new owner for the Lielīvande Manor complex. The auction for the property will begin on 11 November, with a starting price of 371,000 euros. At present, it is the only place where the residents of Īvande can gather; the building still houses the parish council and the library, Latvian Radio reports.

latvia.title: Defence Minister Melnis ready to carry on regardless
latvia.description: Latvian Defence Minister Raivis Melnis would be ready to continue working in his post even if Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (United List) forms a government without the New Unity party, Melnis said on Monday in the Latvian Television programme "Morning Panorama".

latvia.title: Tourism in eastern Latvia was hit by drone alerts
latvia.description: The tourism industry in Latvia's eastern border region has been doing its best to recover from a wave of cancelled reservations in May and June, according to the Ministry of Economics (EM).

latvia.title: Drug users in Latvia getting younger, doctors observe
latvia.description: Organisations working with children and young people have observed that children are getting drunk on alcohol or taking drugs at an increasingly young age – even at primary school age. The number of children admitted to hospital requiring medical assistance following intoxication is on the rise, Latvian Television reported on November 8.

latvia.title: Latvia chairs emergency UN meeting on Ukraine
latvia.description: On 9th November 2026, Minister of Foreign Affairs Baiba Braže will be in the New York (USA) to take part in an emergency meeting of the UN Security Council (UNSC) on the subject of Ukraine.

latvia.title: WATCH AGAIN: Latvia versus France international handball
latvia.description: Enjoy live handball action on Sunday as Latvia's men's team takes on France at the Zemgale Olympic Centre in Jelgava.

latvia.title: Phone scammers rampant in Latvia
latvia.description: This year, telephone scammers have swindled more than 17 million euros from Latvian residents. The number of fraud cases shows no sign of decreasing, and most often the scammers pose as representatives of banks, the State Social Insurance Agency (VSAA), the Road Traffic Safety Directorate (CSDD), courier services or the State Revenue Service, Latvian Radio reported on November 9.

latvia.title: Latvia continues to secure eastern border
latvia.description: Construction of the Baltic defence line continues along Latvia’s eastern border. To hinder the movement of a potential adversary’s vehicles, anti-tank trenches are being dug and concrete obstacles, known as ‘dragon’s teeth’, are being installed. First, trenches are planned to be dug over 89 kilometres, of which four kilometres have been excavated so far. The first 27 kilometres are due to be completed next spring, Latvian Television reported on November 8.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 8th November, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: First snow of winter falls in Latgale region
latvia.description: The first snowflakes of the season were recorded at the Rēzekne observation station on Saturday morning, according to information published by the Latvian Environment, Geology and Meteorology Centre (LVĢMC).

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 6th October, 2026

latvia.title: Latvian government judges itself to have done pretty well
latvia.description: On November 6th, 2026, the Cabinet of Ministers reviewed a report prepared by the State Chancellery on the implementation of the action plan of the government led by Andris Kulbergs. According to its findnings, by October 15th, 2026, 52 out of 61 priority ministerial tasks, or 85%, had been completed, as well as 132 or 71% of the total 185 measures included in the government action plan.

latvia.title: Workers offered chance to improve Latvian language skills
latvia.description: In order to promote the competitiveness of employees and facilitate their inclusion in the work environment, the State Employment Agency (NVA) will offer the opportunity to acquire or improve Latvian language skills free of charge within the framework of the lifelong learning activities of the European Social Fund Plus (ESF+) project “Support for Adult Education”.

latvia.title: Contraband cigs thrown from moving train in Latvia
latvia.description: On 4 November, the State Police detained two Belarusian nationals – a train driver and his assistant – on suspicion of large-scale smuggling. The men threw several packets of illegal cigarettes from a moving train.

latvia.title: Average Latvian salaries are lowest in the Baltics
latvia.description: In 2025, the average annual full-time adjusted salary for employees in the EU was €41 500, reflecting a 4.3% increase from €39 800 in 2024, according to Eurostat data published on November 6th.

latvia.title: Latvia discusses electronic warfare with partners willing to help Ukraine
latvia.description: This week, a plenary session of the Electronic Warfare Coalition took place in Latvia, during which coalition representatives discussed current challenges in the field of electronic warfare, as well as the necessary support for Ukraine to strengthen this capability.

latvia.title: Nepal declines Latvian humanitarian aid
latvia.description: Nepal, which was hit by devastating floods at the end of August, has declined the humanitarian aid offered by Latvia, which had been prepared by the Emergency Medical Service (NMPD) and the State Fire and Rescue Service (VUGD), and consequently, on Friday 6 November, the government revoked the order to provide humanitarian aid to Nepal.

latvia.title: Three for the Weekend: Porta, Patriotic Walk, Belts
latvia.description: The Month of Patriots has begun in Latvia. What will it be this weekend?

latvia.title: Rīga Book Festival starts today
latvia.description: On November 6th and 7th, the traditional Riga Book Festival will offer a rich programme at the National Library of Latvia.

latvia.title: Latvia's influenza vaccination rate low, death rate high by EU standards
latvia.description: Fresh Eurostat data for 2023 and 2024 show that Latvia had one of the lowest rates of influenza vaccination and one of the highest rates of death from influenza.

latvia.title: Latvian public invited to mark Lāčplēsis Day on November 11th
latvia.description: On Lāčplēsis Day (November 11th), commemorative events will be held throughout Latvia, with the participation of soldiers of the National Armed Forces and allies.

latvia.title: Fuel prices up 34% on year in Latvia
latvia.description: Data published by Central Statistical Bureau on November 5 show that, compared with October 2025, the average level of consumer prices for fuels for transport in October 2026 was 34.5 % higher. Diesel prices increased by 38.1 %, petrol prices by 27.9 % and auto gas prices by 12.9 %.

latvia.title: Mārupe, Daugavpils named most business-friendly areas in Latvia
latvia.description: Mārupe Municipality has been recognised as the most business-friendly municipality, whilst Daugavpils has been awarded the status of the most business-friendly city, according to the Latvian Chamber of Commerce and Industry (LTRK).

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 5th November, 2026

latvia.description: After being sworn in earlier this week, Latvia's Saeima deputies are starting to settle in – but that comes with several challenges.

latvia.title: Latvia's 2027 Michelin Guide has 35 restaurants
latvia.description: In the fourth year of the Latvian ‘Michelin’ Guide, a further 12 Latvian restaurants have been added to the selection, according to Michelin.

latvia.title: 14th Saeima's top speakers revealed
latvia.description: Over the past four years, the 14th Saeima adopted a total of 1,078 laws - 140 new ones and 938 amendments to existing laws according to a summary of the activities of the 100 Saeima deputies.

latvia.title: WATCH: Latvian Foreign Minister speaks at NATO command centre
latvia.description: Latvia's Foreign Minister Baiba Braže was in the Netherlands on November 4th at NATO’s Allied Joint Force Command Brunssum and participated in an informal meeting of foreign ministers.

latvia.title: Over half of Latvia's internet users also use AI
latvia.description: According to the annual Central Statistical Bureau survey on the use of information and communication technologies (ICT) in households and by individuals, published on November 5, 58.2 % of internet users in Latvia used generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools in 2026, 23.1 percentage points more than a year earlier.

latvia.title: Major drug bust in Rīga's woods
latvia.description: On 21 October this year, the State Police seized approximately 36 kilograms of various drugs in Rīga, Jūrmala and the surrounding area, the majority of which had been hidden in barrels buried in the ground in the woods. A group of six people has been arrested on suspicion of drug trafficking, the police said.

latvia.title: Koši, raibi un bieži pat neglīti – kāpēc sabiedriskā transporta krēsli ir tādi? Tā nav dizaineru kaprīze
latvia.description: Ikviens, kurš regulāri pārvietojas ar sabiedrisko transportu, droši vien ir pamanījis, ka autobusu, tramvaju un vilcienu sēdekļi bieži vien ir pārsteidzoši raibi. Tajos savijas košas krāsas, sarežģītas ģeometriskas formas un dažādi raksti, haotiski un neloģiski. Varētu domāt, ka tā ir dizaineru iztēles izpausme, taču šādam izskatam ir pavisam praktisks iemesls. Sabiedriskajā transportā sēdekļi ik dienu […]

lithuania.title: V Abú Dhabí jednali zástupci USA, Ukrajiny a Ruska, pokračovat budou ve středu
lithuania.description: V Abú Dhabí skončily rozhovory Spojených států, Ukrajiny a Ruska o ukončení agrese Moskvy, pokračovat budou ve středu. Na místě jsou také zástupci evropských zemí, EU a NATO, kteří se však samotných třístranných rozhovorů přímo neúčastní. Tématem rozhovorů, která se ve třístranném formátu konají poprvé od letošního února, je nejen ukončení války, kterou Rusko rozpoutalo, ale také bezpečnostní záruky pro poválečnou Ukrajinu a budoucí systém evropské bezpečnosti. Konkrétní obsah jednání a jejich vývoj dosud účastníci nekomentovali. Analytici od jednání průlom nečekají.

lithuania.title: Un parlamentar ar vrea să îi propună lui Călin Georgescu să preia conducerea AUR. Peiu: Până în 2030, postul e ocupat de George Simion
lithuania.description: Deputatul Mohammad Murad ar lua în calcul să îi propună lui Călin Georgescu să preia conducerea Alianței pentru Unirea Românilor (AUR), potrivit unor surse politice citate de Mediafax. Contactat de Digi24.ro, liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrișor Peiu, a exclus această posibilitate pentru perioada următoare, menționând că abia în anul 2030 partidul o să organizeze un nou Congres pentru alegerea conducerii.

lithuania.title: Cum ar putea testa Rusia Articolul 5 al NATO. Scenariul îngrijorător pentru Europa, după înfrângerea lui Trump la alegerile din SUA
lithuania.description: Înfrângerea republicanilor la alegerile de la jumătatea mandatului din Statele Unite ar putea avea consecințe importante asupra politicii externe a președintelui Donald Trump. Într-un scenariu extrem, Rusia ar putea încerca să testeze solidaritatea NATO, mizând pe faptul că Washingtonul nu va interveni în sprijinul aliaților europeni, avertizează experta în relații internaționale Liana Fix, într-o analiză publicată de revista germană FOCUS.

lithuania.title: Nicoleta Pauliuc, către Ilie Bolojan: Riscaţi să duceţi PNL pe un drum în care dezbaterea e înlocuită cu ultimatumul. Nu mă intimidaţi

lithuania.title: Premieră medicală la Iași: cel mai mic pacient din România a primit un rinichi de la un bebeluș donator. „Am crezut că e un vis”
lithuania.description: Șanse nesperate la o viață normală pentru doi copii, de doi, respectiv șase ani. A primit fiecare câte un rinichi nou, în urma unor intervenții contracronometru realizate de medicii de la Spitalul Parhon din Iași. În cazul copilului de doi ani, este o premieră: este cel mai tânăr pacient transplantat până acum în România. Salvarea a venit tot de la un copil, care s-a stins la nici un an și jumătate.

lithuania.title: Peiu: „AUR va încerca să depună moțiune de cenzură dacă Guvernul își angajează răspunderea pe reforma administrativ-teritorială”
lithuania.description: AUR va încerca să depună o moțiune de cenzură dacă Guvernul își va angaja răspunderea pe reforma administrativ-teritorială, a anunțat luni liderul senatorilor formațiunii, Petrișor Peiu. Acesta susține că proiectul trebuie dezbătut în Parlament și negociat cu toate partidele, iar reorganizarea trebuie aplicată la nivel național, inclusiv în București.

lithuania.title: Ilie Bolojan anunță că ușile PNL sunt deschise: pe cine așteaptă liderul liberal să se alăture partidului
lithuania.description: Preşedintele PNL, senatorul Ilie Bolojan a făcut un apel, luni, către toţi oamenii care stăpânesc un domeniu, care au soluţii, să se alăture partidului, el arătând că cei care îşi vor vedea soluţiile preluate în politicile publice susţinute de PNL, uşile partidului sunt deschise.

lithuania.title: PSD pregătește reforma administrativ-teritorială: șase criterii pentru reorganizarea localităților. Când va fi gata documentul
lithuania.description: PSD propune șase criterii pentru stabilirea localităților sustenabile, în cadrul reformei administrativ-teritoriale, care ar urma să fie finalizată în luna martie. Printre cele luate în calcul se numără populația, sustenabilitatea economică, capacitatea administrativă, conectivitatea, accesul la servicii de bază și infrastructura publică. Europarlamentarul social-democrat Dragoș Benea, coordonatorul grupului de lucru pentru reformă, a precizat luni că primarii își vor duce actualele mandate până la capăt, în 2028, și că nu trebuie să existe temeri în această privință.

lithuania.title: Kauno arkivyskupija pranešė apie kunigo mirtį
lithuania.description: Kauno arkivyskupija pranešė, kad lapkričio 10 d., eidamas 87-uosius metus, Marijampolės globos namuose mirė kunigas Vladas Luzgauskas.

lithuania.title: JAV gynybos sekretorius siekį surengti jam apkaltą vadina politiniu spektakliu
lithuania.description: JAV gynybos sekretorius Pete'as Hegsethas antradienį pasmerkė siekį surengti jam apkaltą ir pavadino tai prezidento Donaldo Trumpo oponento Kongrese politiniu spektakliu.

lithuania.title: Parduotuvėje didelę prekių dėžę laikęs vyras pro kasas išėjo tarsi nieko neįsigijęs
lithuania.description: Policija tiria vagystę sostinės Stoties rajone ir prašo pagalbos nustatant užfiksuoto vyro tapatybę.

lithuania.title: Gitanas Nausėda: bet kokia agresija prieš NATO valstybes turi būti pasmerkta žlugti
lithuania.description: Prezidentas Gitanas Nausėda, susitikęs su Prancūzijos prezidentu Emmanueliu Macronu, pareiškė, kad Rusijos vykdomos hibridinės atakos vis dažniau kelia tiesioginę grėsmę NATO valstybių saugumui, todėl būtina stiprinti Aljanso atgrasymą ir oro gynybą.

lithuania.title: Kyjivo delegacija: JAV tarpininkaujamų Ukrainos ir Rusijos derybų pirmoji diena baigėsi
lithuania.description: Ukraina ir Rusija antradienį Abu Dabyje baigė pirmąją JAV tarpininkaujamų derybų – pirmųjų tokių derybų nuo vasario – dieną, naujienų agentūrai AFP pranešė šaltinis Ukrainos delegacijoje.

lithuania.title: Gadi Eisenkotui bandant suformuoti vyriausybę, prisieks naujasis Izraelio parlamentas
lithuania.description: Izraelio naujasis parlamentas prisieks antradienį, ministrui pirmininkui Benjaminui Netanyahu (Benjaminui Netanjahu) prarandant daugumą, o jo varžovas Gadi Eisenkotas (Gadis Aizenkotas) vis dar mėgina suformuoti naują vyriausybę.

lithuania.title: ES padavė į teismą technologijų įmones dėl vėluojančios pasienio sistemos
lithuania.description: Europos Sąjunga (ES) padavė į teismą tris technologijų bendroves dėl vėlavimo sukurti naują biometrinę pasienio sistemą, dėl kurio diegimo Europos oro uostuose susidarė milžiniškos eilės.

lithuania.title: Zelenskis papasakojo, ką atsakė JAV dėl Donbaso perdavimo Rusijai
lithuania.description: Ukrainos prezidentas Volodymyras Zelenskis netiki, kad, jei karą pradėjusiam Vladimirui Putinui būtų atiduota ta Donbaso dalis, kurios dar neokupavo Rusijos pajėgos, Kremliaus vadovas sudėtų ginklus.

lithuania.title: Ugniagesiai su JAV specialistais pirmą kartą treniruojasi reaguoti į chemines, radiologines grėsmes
lithuania.description: Lietuvos ugniagesiai su JAV specialistais pirmą kartą treniruojasi aptikti ir reaguoti į chemines, biologines, radiologines ir branduolines grėsmes, antradienį pranešė Priešgaisrinės apsaugos ir gelbėjimo departamentas (PAGD).

lithuania.title: Mokslininkams sukritikavus švietimo sistemą, Raminta Popovienė žada tęsti ugdymo programų peržiūrą
lithuania.description: Švietimo, mokslo ir sporto ministrė Raminta Popovienė sako, kad nuo rugsėjo matematikos ugdymo programa jau susiaurinta, tačiau ją ir kitas ugdymo programas būtina toliau peržiūrėti, siekiant mažinti mokinių krūvį ir daugiau dėmesio skirti mokymo turiniui.

lithuania.title: Paryžius: Ukraina ir Prancūzija sveikina JAV pastangas derybose Abu Dabyje
lithuania.description: Ukraina ir Prancūzija palankiai įvertino Vašingtono pastangas antradienį prasidėjusiose JAV tarpininkaujamose derybose tarp Maskvos ir Kyjivo.

lithuania.title: Prancūzijai apkaltinus Iraną dėl atakų prieš šaldytuvus, ES ruošia bendrą atsaką
lithuania.description: Prancūzijai apkaltinus Iraną dėl kibernetinės atakos prieš šimtus prekybos centrų šaldytuvų, Europos Sąjunga (ES) antradienį pareiškė, kad sieks pateikti „greitą ir vieningą atsaką“.

lithuania.title: Baltijos jūroje – povandeninių laivų medžioklės pratybos
lithuania.description: Aštuonios NATO šalys Baltijos jūroje pradėjo penkias dienas truksiančias kovos su povandeniniais laivais pratybas, o vienas iš aukščiausio rango vadų itin tylius povandeninius laivus pavadino nuolatine grėsme.

lithuania.title: Rusija pirmą kartą į Tolimuosius Rytus perkėlė visus strateginius bombonešius
lithuania.description: Rusijos vadovybė aviacijos bazėje „Ukrainka“, esančioje Amūro srityje, vienu metu sutelkė 47 strateginius raketnešius-bombonešius – gerokai daugiau nei kituose Rusijos kariniuose aerodromuose, praneša OSINT projektas „AviVector“. Šis precedento per visą karo laikotarpį neturintis aviacijos perkėlimas į Tolimuosius Rytus įvyko po vasarą Ukrainos suduotų smūgių ankstesnei pagrindinei jų bazavimo vietai – „Engels-2“ aerodromui Saratovo srityje.
